description.narrative: (Pakistan): The COVID-19 pandemic and the catastrophic floods in 2022 have demonstrated the critical need to strengthen and build a resilient health system that can withstand shocks, such as pandemics or the effects of climate change. The objective of the Integrated Health Systems Strengthening and Service Delivery (IHSS-SD) activity is to strengthen Pakistan's health system to better provide quality essential health services and activities. These activities include prevention, detection, and control of TB and other infectious diseases, including within the framework of Global Health Security (GHS). ..This activity will continue to support and scale-up the detection, treatment, and prevention of emerging infectious diseases as well as tuberculosis at the federal and provincial levels. It will also help the Government of Pakistan scale up disease surveillance build a more resilient health system, support critical post-flood recovery activities, and make crucial health security investments, as well as strengthen and institutionalize GHS activities, including expanding disease surveillance and response and the One Health platform for improving coordination between systems for human and animal diseases...This IM contributes $3.7 million the Other Infectious Diseases earmark, $3.7 million to the Global Health Security earmark, and $3.7 million to the Climate Programs earmark.....
